items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I got married in 1914, on the 19th day of March. You know I used to play at the St. Dominic Hall. And that's where I met my wife.

ctx.x: Did you see many musicians you knew in other towns? No, I didn't see any. You didn't try to play music in between or anything? You just come and go, huh? Just come and go is right. Well we want to get your wife in here. Did you fall in love with your wife and marry her because she was a musician or because you took care of?
No. I got married in 1914, on the 19th day of March. You know I used to play at the St. Dominic Hall. And that's where I met my wife. I met my wife at St. Dominic Hall.
Has she always been in sympathy with your music activities?
